sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，在加利福尼亚州的一处葡萄园内发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，体内的血也被抽干了。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机来隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，人们只知道她叫无名氏。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 随后，侦探们终于得知了她的名字——阿达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但是，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是罪案档案推介的全新系列，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: Reinhold sat stunned in the soft glow of his computer screen.
sentences.zh: 莱因霍尔德呆坐在电脑屏幕柔和的光芒前。

sentences.en: It was approaching dawn on Tuesday July 9, 2002, and the 23-year-old medical student had been up all night on the internet.
sentences.zh: 那是2002年7月9日星期二的黎明前夕，这位23岁的医学生整晚都在上网。

sentences.en: What he had witnessed had disturbed him measurably, and Reinhold had to tell somebody.
sentences.zh: 他目睹的一切让他深感不安，莱因霍尔德觉得必须告诉某个人。

sentences.en: He opened up a new email template and began typing.
sentences.zh: 他打开一个新的电子邮件模板，开始打字。

sentences.en: Ladies and gentlemen of the Federal Criminal Bureau, my name is Reinhold.
sentences.zh: 联邦刑事局的各位领导和同仁，我叫莱因霍尔德。

sentences.en: He went on to describe his experiences online the night before.
sentences.zh: 接着，他描述了自己前一天晚上的网络经历。

sentences.en: Seeking horrifying thrills, Reinhold had used widely popular search engines to explore the darkest recesses of the internet for content that would shock him.
sentences.zh: 为了寻求令人毛骨悚然的刺激，莱因霍尔德使用广受欢迎的搜索引擎，探索了互联网最黑暗的角落，寻找能震惊到他的内容。

sentences.en: They led him to a forum where a small but active group of users interacted excitedly over their shared interests in taboo and or forbidden fetishes.
sentences.zh: 这些搜索将他引向了一个论坛，那里有一小群活跃的用户，他们因共同痴迷于禁忌或被禁止的恋物癖而兴奋地互动。

sentences.en: Reinhold thought that what he was reading was just erotic roleplay based entirely in fantasy.
sentences.zh: 莱因霍尔德以为他所读到的只是完全基于幻想的色情角色扮演。

sentences.en: His attention was soon drawn to an advertisement posted by a user named Frankie.
sentences.zh: 不久，他的注意力被一个名为弗兰基的用户发布的一则广告吸引了。

sentences.en: Titled, Boys Sought for Butchering, the accompanying text read,
sentences.zh: 广告标题是《寻求屠宰的男孩》，随附的正文写道：

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Frankie from Germany.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是来自德国的弗兰基。

sentences.en: I'm looking for young men between 18 and 30 to butcher.
sentences.zh: 我在寻找18到30岁之间供我宰杀的年轻男子。

sentences.en: If you have a normal build, then come to me.
sentences.zh: 如果你体型正常，那就来找我吧。

sentences.en: I'll butcher you and eat your delicious flesh.
sentences.zh: 我会宰了你，吃掉你美味的肉。

sentences.en: Driven by curiosity, Reinhold sent Frankie an email.
sentences.zh: 出于好奇，莱因霍尔德给弗兰基发了一封电子邮件。

sentences.en: In it, he mentioned his age and that he lived in the Austrian town of Innsbruck.
sentences.zh: 在信中，他提到了自己的年龄，并说自己住在奥地利的因斯布鲁克镇。

sentences.en: How many boys have you butchered and eaten, Reinhold typed before clicking send.
sentences.zh: 你宰杀并吃掉了多少个男孩？莱因霍尔德打完字，点击了发送。

sentences.en: He received a prompt response.
sentences.zh: 他很快收到了回复。

sentences.en: Well, let's say I have experience, Frankie wrote back.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这么说吧，我有经验，弗兰基回信道。

sentences.en: In any case, you wouldn't be the firSt.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，你不会是第一个。

sentences.en: Reinhold continued reading the email from Frankie.
sentences.zh: 莱因霍尔德继续阅读弗兰基的邮件。

sentences.en: In reference to Reinhold's age of 23, Frankie had written,
sentences.zh: 针对莱因霍尔德23岁的年龄，弗兰基写道：

sentences.en: That's an optimal butchering age.
sentences.zh: 这是最佳的宰杀年龄。

sentences.en: The body has just matured and is still very tender.
sentences.zh: 此时身体刚刚成熟，而且非常鲜嫩。

sentences.en: He requested that Reinhold tell him more about himself, specifically his height and weight, before signing off his email with,
sentences.zh: 他要求莱因霍尔德多介绍一下自己，特别是身高和体重，并在邮件末尾署名：

sentences.en: Your master butcher.
sentences.zh: 你的屠夫大师。

sentences.en: Frankie.
sentences.zh: 弗兰基。

sentences.en: Reinhold was shocked.
sentences.zh: 莱因霍尔德大惊失色。

sentences.en: The lines, I have experience, and you wouldn't be the first, implied Frankie wasn't just pretending.
sentences.zh: “我有经验”和“你不会是第一个”这两句话暗示，弗兰基并非只是在假装。

sentences.en: Wanting no part in what he had planned, Reinhold replied,
sentences.zh: 莱因霍尔德不想卷入他策划的阴谋，于是回复道：

sentences.en: I don't want to be butchered.
sentences.zh: 我不想被宰杀。

sentences.en: I want to live.
sentences.zh: 我想活下去。

sentences.en: He then asked Frankie what compels someone to kill and eat other people.
sentences.zh: 接着，他质问弗兰基是什么驱使一个人去杀害并吃掉其他人。

sentences.en: The question is as old as humanity itself, Frankie answered.
sentences.zh: 这个问题和人类本身一样古老，弗兰基回答道。

sentences.en: For myself, I'm not interested in killing someone in cold blood because then I would be simply grabbing somebody and eating him, and I would be just a common killer.
sentences.zh: 就我而言，我对冷血杀人毫无兴趣，因为那样的话我只是随便抓个人吃掉，我就会沦为一个普通的杀人犯。

sentences.en: I'm looking for people who have a desire to die, for whatever reason.
sentences.zh: 我在寻找那些渴望死去的人，无论出于什么原因。

sentences.en: Some of them dream of being butchered, others simply want to end their lives because they have no future prospects.
sentences.zh: 他们有的人梦想被宰杀，有的则只是因为看不到未来而想结束生命。

sentences.en: I then prepare for them a death such as they desire for themselves.
sentences.zh: 然后，我会为他们准备一场他们自己所渴望的死亡。

sentences.en: My wish since childhood has been to have someone entirely to myself, and then to absorb him into me by eating him.
sentences.zh: 我自小的愿望就是拥有一个完全属于我的人，然后通过吃掉他将他融入我体内。

sentences.en: Reinhold's response was swift and blunt.
sentences.zh: 莱因霍尔德的回信迅速而直白。

sentences.en: You are not doing these people any favour by killing them.
sentences.zh: 你杀害这些人根本算不上是在帮他们恩赐。

sentences.en: You look exclusively for young men and exploit someone's life crisis.
sentences.zh: 你专门寻找年轻男性，利用了别人的生活危机。

sentences.en: Everyone sometimes reaches a point where he can't cope with life.
sentences.zh: 每个人有时都会陷入无法应对生活的绝境。

sentences.en: Sometimes they have no friends and no family and no one they can talk with.
sentences.zh: 有时他们没有朋友，没有家人，也没有可以倾诉的人。

sentences.en: No, what you do is not admirable, but pathologically perverted.
sentences.zh: 不，你的所作所为绝不值得称赞，而是病态的变态。

sentences.en: People who come to you and whose fate you seal would have done better to go to a psychologist, and you too should go to a psychologist, for even if you won't admit it to yourself,
sentences.zh: 那些找到你并被你决定命运的人，原本最好去找心理医生；你也应该去看心理医生，因为即使你对自己闭口不提，

sentences.en: you are a cold-blooded murderer.
sentences.zh: 你也是一个冷血杀手。

sentences.en: By the time their correspondence had ended, the sun was beginning to rise.
sentences.zh: 当他们的通信结束时，太阳已经开始升起。

sentences.en: Reinhold had spent a sleepless night glued to his computer emailing back and forth with Frankie.
sentences.zh: 莱因霍尔德度过了一个不眠之夜，双眼紧盯着电脑，与弗兰基一封接一封地发邮件。

sentences.en: Concerned by what he had uncovered, he reached out to Germany's Federal Criminal Bureau via email.
sentences.zh: 由于对他所发现的事情感到担忧，他通过电子邮件联系了德国联邦刑事局。

sentences.en: After detailing his interactions with Frankie, Reinhold ended his email by stating,
sentences.zh: 在详细说明了自己与弗兰基的互动后，莱因霍尔德在邮件末尾写道：

sentences.en: I don't know how to handle it.
sentences.zh: 我不知道该如何处理这件事。

sentences.en: At 5.49am, Reinhold clicked send.
sentences.zh: 凌晨5点49分，莱因霍尔德点击了发送。

sentences.en: It took 19 days before anyone at the Bureau addressed Reinhold's email.
sentences.zh: 过了19天，联邦刑事局才有人处理莱因霍尔德的邮件。

sentences.en: A chief criminal commissioner eventually looked into the matter by going undercover online and contacting Frankie directly.
sentences.zh: 一名高级刑事专员最终着手调查此事，他隐瞒身份上网并直接联系了弗兰基。

sentences.en: Feigning interest in the topic of cannibalism, they emailed Frankie to obtain information that might lead to his real-world identity.
sentences.zh: 他们假装对食人话题感兴趣，给弗兰基发邮件以获取可能顺藤摸瓜查出其现实身份的信息。

sentences.en: The message read,
sentences.zh: 信息写道：

sentences.en: I stumbled on your post where you're looking for boys to butcher.
sentences.zh: 我偶然看到了你的帖子，你在寻找供宰杀的男孩。

sentences.en: I find it fascinating.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这太迷人了。

sentences.en: Please write to me about how you imagine it.
sentences.zh: 请写信告诉我你是如何想象这一过程的。

sentences.en: Frankie sent a long and detailed reply later that night that began,
sentences.zh: 那天深夜，弗兰基发来了一封长篇且细节满满的回复，信的开头写道：

sentences.en: One wants to know whom one is eating.
sentences.zh: 人总得知道自己吃的是谁。

sentences.en: Frankie then explained that during the final two days of their encounter, he would place his victim on a liquid diet to keep their intestines empty for the butchering process.
sentences.zh: 弗兰基随后解释说，在他们会面的最后两天，他会让受害者只喝流食，以保持肠道空空如也，为接下来的宰杀过程做准备。

sentences.en: That would begin on the last day, or day X as Frankie called it.
sentences.zh: 屠宰将从最后一天开始，或者按弗兰基的说法，即X日。

sentences.en: He'd wake his victim early, wash and shave them in the bathroom, then take them to his slaughter room.
sentences.zh: 他会早早叫醒受害者，在浴室里为他们清洗并刮毛，然后带他们去他的屠宰室。

sentences.en: He offered to kill the undercover commissioner in whatever way they'd like, fully conscious or drugged.
sentences.zh: 他表示愿意以任何受害者喜欢的方式杀死这位卧底专员，无论是完全清醒还是药物麻醉。

sentences.en: Their choice.
sentences.zh: 悉听尊便。

sentences.en: I'll carve you up to prepare many delightful dishes from your delicious flesh,
sentences.zh: 我会把你切碎，用你美味的肉做出许多令人垂涎的菜肴，

sentences.en: Frankie told the commissioner, who he thought was a 26-year-old that lived in the German state of Hesse.
sentences.zh: 弗兰基对这位专员说道，他以为对方是住在德国黑森州的一名26岁青年。

sentences.en: Incidentally, Frankie wrote, I am also from Hesse, near Castle.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，弗兰基写道，我也来自黑森州，城堡附近。

sentences.en: He ended the email as he had with
sentences.zh: 他在邮件末尾写下了几周前对

sentences.en: Reinhold weeks prior.
sentences.zh: 莱因霍尔德说过的话：

sentences.en: Your master butcher.
sentences.zh: 你的屠夫大师。

sentences.en: Frankie.
sentences.zh: 弗兰基。

sentences.en: At this point, there was nothing to prove that
sentences.zh: 此时此刻，没有任何证据证明

sentences.en: Frankie had killed or devoured anyone.
sentences.zh: 弗兰基杀害或吞食过任何人。

sentences.en: With no evidence of a crime having taken place, the Federal Criminal Bureau cast the case aside.
sentences.zh: 由于没有发生犯罪的证据，联邦刑事局将此案搁置一旁。

sentences.en: What he spoke of was so outrageous and inconceivable, it was easy to believe that he was just some imaginative deviant dramatising his gruesome and violent kink online.
sentences.zh: 他所谈论的事情实在是荒诞不经、匪夷所思，人们很容易相信他只是一名富有想象力的变态，在网上将自己毛骨悚然的暴力性癖进行戏剧化表演。

sentences.en: But Reinhold felt otherwise.
sentences.zh: 但莱因霍尔德不这么认为。

sentences.en: He remained convinced that he had interacted with a real-world killer.
sentences.zh: 他坚信自己与一个现实生活中的杀人犯有过互动。

sentences.en: Five months after his interactions with Frankie, and upon realising authorities were no longer pursuing the matter, Reinhold filed a criminal complaint for the suspicion of murder.
sentences.zh: 在与弗兰基互动五个月后，当意识到当局不再追查此事时，莱因霍尔德以涉嫌谋杀罪名提起了刑事控告。

sentences.en: He addressed how the accused had expressed experience in the field of cannibalism,
sentences.zh: 他在诉状中指出被告曾表达过自己在食人领域的经验，

sentences.en: which gave Reinhold the well-founded suspicion that, at least in one case, he had killed a person.
sentences.zh: 这让莱因霍尔德产生充分的合理怀疑，即被告至少在某一桩案件中杀害过一个人。

sentences.en: It took another 44 days before any further action was taken.
sentences.zh: 又过了44天，当局才采取了进一步行动。

sentences.en: By now, the Bureau had obtained Frankie's internet provider address.
sentences.zh: 此时，联邦刑事局已经获取了弗兰基的网络服务提供商地址。

sentences.en: This allowed them to locate the computer where he sent his emails, as well as the device's internet service customer information.
sentences.zh: 这使他们能够定位到他发送电子邮件的电脑，以及该设备的互联网服务客户信息。

sentences.en: The computer was pinpointed to a residential address in the medieval town of Roltenborg in Hesse,
sentences.zh: 这台电脑被精准定位到黑森州中世纪小镇罗尔滕堡的一处住宅地址，

sentences.en: specifically in the hamlet of Wusterfeld.
sentences.zh: 具体位于武斯特费尔德村。

sentences.en: The internet service it used was contracted to a Mr Armin Maivus.
sentences.zh: 其使用的网络服务签约户名为阿尔明·麦武斯先生。

sentences.en: The suspicion of murder complaint filed by Reinhold was delegated to the District Court of Roltenborg.
sentences.zh: 莱因霍尔德提起的涉嫌谋杀控告被移交给罗尔滕堡地方法院。

sentences.en: Even though Reinhold's accusations were based solely on text on the internet, the court ruled that Frankie's online confessions constituted suspicion of presentation of violence.
sentences.zh: 尽管莱因霍尔德的指控完全基于网上的文字，但法院裁定，弗兰基网上的供述构成了涉嫌宣扬暴力罪。

sentences.en: This was enough for them to issue a search warrant for the Wusterfeld address where Frankie had sent his emails.
sentences.zh: 这足以让他们对弗兰基发送电子邮件的武斯特费尔德住所签发搜查令。

sentences.en: The three-storey, 36-room, Tudor-style Wusterfeld home was an impressive residence, but it had seen better days.
sentences.zh: 这座拥有三层楼、36个房间、都铎风格的武斯特费尔德住宅曾是一处气派的宅邸，但早已今非昔比。

sentences.en: Built in the Middle Ages around 900 AD, the manor set on a 3,000 square metre plot of land of mostly meadows, with an outbuilding that was previously used as a stable.
sentences.zh: 该庄园建于中世纪公元900年左右，坐落在一片占地3000平方米的土地上，四周多为草地，还附带一栋曾用作马厩的附属建筑。

sentences.en: Its half-timbered facade looked slightly askew, as the doors, windows and dormers were positioned without any sense of symmetry.
sentences.zh: 它那半木结构的正面看起来有些歪斜，因为门、窗和老虎窗的布局毫无对称感。

sentences.en: The property was owned by the Maivus family, who had purchased the decrepit manor with the intention of renovating it into a functioning boarding house.
sentences.zh: 该房产属于麦武斯家族，他们买下这座破败的庄园是为了将其翻新成一家营运的寄宿公寓。

sentences.en: Having failed that, the manor had been permanently stuck in an unfinished, worsening state.
sentences.zh: 由于未能如愿，这座庄园便永久陷入了未完工且不断恶化的状态中。

sentences.en: Of the five family members who had settled in the home, only one remained.
sentences.zh: 当年搬进这栋房子的五位家庭成员中，如今只剩下一人。

sentences.en: The front iron gate was open when the police arrived at the Wusterfeld
sentences.zh: 2002年12月10日星期二早晨，当警察抵达武斯特费尔德

sentences.en: Manor on the morning of Tuesday December 10, 2002.
sentences.zh: 庄园时，正面的铁门是开着的。

sentences.en: They made their way up the gravel drive, and upon reaching the house, banged the bronze lion's head knocker on the front door.
sentences.zh: 他们顺着碎石车道走上去，来到房子前，敲响了前门上的青铜狮头门环。

sentences.en: A tall, lean man with thinning, dark blonde hair and pale eyes soon appeared.
sentences.zh: 不久，一个身材高瘦、深金色头发日渐稀疏、目光苍白的男子出现了。

sentences.en: It was the sole homeowner-occupier, 41-year-old
sentences.zh: 他就是房屋的唯一业主兼住户、41岁的

sentences.en: Armin Maivus.
sentences.zh: 阿尔明·麦武斯。

sentences.en: He was in the process of getting ready for work and was surprised to see the officers, who handed him their search warrant.
sentences.zh: 他当时正准备去上班，看到警察时感到十分意外，警察随即将搜查令交给了他。

sentences.en: The inside of the house was dark and musky.
sentences.zh: 房子里面阴暗而又散发着霉味。

sentences.en: Dust covered almost every surface, wallpaper was peeling, the carpets were stained, cobwebs hung from the walls, and dead rodents were spotted in the corners.
sentences.zh: 几乎每个表面都覆盖着灰尘，壁纸正在剥落，地毯沾满了污渍，墙上挂着蜘蛛网，角落里还能看到死去的啮齿动物。

sentences.en: Most rooms were filled to the ceiling with furniture, appliances, clothing, and or computing equipment.
sentences.zh: 大多数房间里塞满了家具、电器、衣物和或电脑设备，一直堆到了天花板上。

sentences.en: Some were so crammed with junk that the officers couldn't even get into them.
sentences.zh: 有些房间杂物堆得如此满满当当，以至于警员们甚至无法入内。

sentences.en: The bathrooms were equally filthy.
sentences.zh: 浴室同样肮脏不堪。

sentences.en: Only a few rooms appeared lived in and semi-maintained, including a kitchen, dining room, and two computer work rooms that contained a plethora of tech
sentences.zh: 只有少数几个房间看起来有人居住并经过半维护，其中包括厨房、餐厅以及两间计算机工作室，里面摆放着大量科技

sentences.en: equipment, including a large collection of videotapes and computer discs.
sentences.zh: 设备，包括大量的录像带和电脑光盘。

sentences.en: On the top floor of the building was a traditional smoke room once used to store and cure meat and fish.
sentences.zh: 大楼顶层是一个传统的烟熏室，以前曾用于存放和腌制肉类及鱼类。

sentences.en: Little remained from when the room was used in this manner, aside from an old oil stove and a thick layer of soot that covered the walls.
sentences.zh: 除了一个旧油炉和覆盖墙壁的厚厚一层烟灰外，这个房间过去作为他用时留下的痕迹已所剩无几。

sentences.en: The metal frame of a single bed had since been brought in and was rusting in one corner of the room.

sentences.en: Frankie stroked his face to soothe him.
sentences.zh: 弗兰基抚摸着他的脸来安慰他。

sentences.en: Before Kator drifted off, the pair finally revealed to each other their real names.
sentences.zh: 在卡托昏昏欲睡之前，两人终于向对方透露了各自的真实姓名。

sentences.en: Up until this point, they had only known and referred to each other by their online usernames from the cannibal foruMs.
sentences.zh: 在此之前，他们只知道并用彼此在食人论坛上的网名来称呼对方。

sentences.en: I'm Armin, Frankie said.
sentences.zh: 弗兰基说：“我是阿明（Armin）。”

sentences.en: Decades before police came knocking on his door, an eight-year-old Armin Maivas wandered his family's Wusterfeld Manor feeling incredibly lonely.
sentences.zh: 在警察敲响他的门几代人之前，八岁的阿明·迈韦斯（Armin Meiwes）在家人位于乌斯特费尔德的庄园里游荡，感到无比孤独。

sentences.en: His mother, Valtraud Maivas, had moved Armin and his two older half-brothers to the expansive property
sentences.zh: 他的母亲瓦尔特劳德·迈韦斯（Valtraud Meiwes）把阿明和他的两个同母异父的哥哥搬到了这处广阔的房产中，

sentences.en: shortly after Armin's father had abandoned them to pursue a relationship with his girlfriend.
sentences.zh: 就在阿明的父亲抛弃他们去追求他女朋友之后不久。

sentences.en: Armin had loved his father, but when he ran desperately after his father's car, howling for him not to leave, his father didn't even glance at the rearview mirror.
sentences.zh: 阿明曾经很爱他的父亲，但当他拼命追赶父亲的车、大喊着叫父亲不要离开时，他的父亲甚至连后视镜都没有看一眼。

sentences.en: Armin despised him after that.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，阿明鄙视他。

sentences.en: Armin's brothers didn't stick around long either.
sentences.zh: 阿明的兄弟们也没有待多久。

sentences.en: They moved out, leaving Armin alone with his mother.
sentences.zh: 他们搬了出去，只留下阿明和他的母亲孤男寡女。

sentences.en: To Valtraud Maivas, men were not independent individuals with their own interests and needs.
sentences.zh: 对瓦尔特劳德·迈韦斯来说，男人不是有着自己兴趣和需求的独立个体。

sentences.en: They were malleable things that she could shape and control.
sentences.zh: 他们是可以由她塑造和控制的软泥。

sentences.en: Once his father and brothers were gone, Armin was the only man left in Valtraud's life, and she began to shape him accordingly.
sentences.zh: 一旦他的父亲和兄弟们离开，阿明就成了瓦尔特劳德生活中仅存的男性，她开始相应地塑造他。

sentences.en: Valtraud didn't do any housework, so the extensive upkeep of the manor fell to Armin.
sentences.zh: 瓦尔特劳德不做任何家务，因此庄园的大量 upkeep（维护）落在了阿明身上。

sentences.en: Referring to him as her little servant,
sentences.zh: 瓦尔特劳德把他叫做她的小仆人，

sentences.en: Valtraud ordered Armin around the home, expecting him to cook and clean when he wasn't at school.
sentences.zh: 在家里呼来喝去，指望他在没上学的时候做饭和打扫卫生。

sentences.en: When he was, Armin was teased for his relationship with his domineering mother.
sentences.zh: 上学时，阿明因为与他专横母亲的关系而遭到戏弄。

sentences.en: Other students called him a mother's boy and made fun of the traditional lederhosen he wore at her insistence.
sentences.zh: 其他同学叫他“妈宝男”，并取笑他坚持穿的传统巴伐利亚皮裤。

sentences.en: In the aftermath of her failed marriage, Valtraud withdrew from society, fearing further rejection.
sentences.zh: 在婚姻失败的余波中，瓦尔特劳德由于害怕遭到进一步的拒绝而退出了社交圈。

sentences.en: This fear led her to foster a sheltered and oppressive life for Armin, at times sabotaging his relationships with others so he'd only have her.
sentences.zh: 这种恐惧促使她为阿明营造了一种受庇护且压抑的生活，有时甚至破坏了他与其他人的关系，这样他就只有她了。

sentences.en: She had him live in the room across from her own and would summon him by banging the end of her walking stick on the hard floor.
sentences.zh: 她让他住在她自己房间对面，并会通过用手杖末端敲击硬地板来召唤他。

sentences.en: Despite going to great lengths to keep Armin in her life, Valtraud was very rarely affectionate towards him.
sentences.zh: 尽管为了把阿明留在身边而不遗余力，但瓦尔特劳德对他的温情却少之又少。

sentences.en: She treated Armin downright coolly, with the amount of times she hugged him each year countable on a single hand.
sentences.zh: 她对阿明可以说是极其冷淡，她每年拥抱他的次数一只手都数得过来。

sentences.en: Valtraud also feigned illness as a means to control.
sentences.zh: 瓦尔特劳德还假装生病作为控制的手段。

sentences.en: One day, a 15-year-old Armin was helping his mother get downstairs after she had complained of leg pain.
sentences.zh: 有一天，十五岁的阿明在抱怨腿痛的母亲下楼时帮了她一把。

sentences.en: He thought to himself, one good shove and it's finally over.
sentences.zh: 他心想，只要轻轻一推，一切就终于结束了。

sentences.en: Instead of unleashing his rage, Armin internalised it.
sentences.zh: 阿明没有释放他的愤怒，而是将其内化了。

sentences.en: He hated his own cowardice and how his devotion and eagerness to please overrode his ability to express his true feelings.
sentences.zh: 他痛恨自己的懦弱，痛恨自己的忠诚和取悦他人的渴望如何压倒了他表达真实感受的能力。

sentences.en: The problem was, even though his mother was a burden, she was the last meaningful person in his life.
sentences.zh: 问题是，尽管他的母亲是个负担，但她却是他生命中最后一个有意义的人。

sentences.en: Armin feared losing her, and he suspected she felt the same about him.
sentences.zh: 阿明害怕失去她，他怀疑她对他的感觉也是如此。

sentences.en: Still, she couldn't fill the place of the male role model that Armin desperately sought.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，她还是无法填补阿明拼命寻找的男性榜样的位置。

sentences.en: From a young age, Armin relied on his imagination to escape his reality.
sentences.zh: 从小到大，阿明都依靠自己的想象力来逃避现实。

sentences.en: He would lose himself in books, with the dark fairy tales written by German brothers Jacob and Wilhelm Grimm becoming treasured fantasy worlds he could revisit over and over.
sentences.zh: 他会沉浸在书籍中，德国格林兄弟（Jacob and Wilhelm Grimm）撰写的黑暗童话成了他可以一遍又一遍重温的珍贵奇幻世界。

sentences.en: Some days, Armin would track the mountainous countryside at the rear of his home with a brother's Grimm book in hand, looking for somewhere to read in private.
sentences.zh: 有时，阿明手里拿着一本格林童话，在自家后面的山区乡村中搜寻，寻找一个可以独自阅读的地方。

sentences.en: On one such occasion, a ten-year-old Armin sat beneath a tree and opened his book to his favourite fairy tale, Hansel and Gretel.
sentences.zh: 在这样的一次经历中，十岁的阿明坐在一棵树下，翻开他的书，找到了他最喜欢的童话故事《糖果屋》（Hansel and Gretel）。

sentences.en: One of the most popular stories in the brothers' Grimm collection, the narrative follows two children lost in a foreSt.
sentences.zh: 作为格林兄弟作品集中最受欢迎的故事之一，这个故事讲述了两个在森林里迷路的孩子。

sentences.en: Eventually, they stumble across a house made of gingerbread with an old woman inside who promises to help them.
sentences.zh: 最终，他们无意中发现了一座姜饼做成的房子，里面有一个答应帮助他们的老妇人。

sentences.en: She is actually an evil witch who captures Hansel and Gretel.
sentences.zh: 她其实是一个俘虏了韩塞尔和葛丽特的邪恶女巫。

sentences.en: Armin would have a physical reaction whenever he read this story.
sentences.zh: 每当阿明读到这个故事时，他都会产生生理反应。

sentences.en: His heart rate would increase, with each page turn bringing him closer to the part that truly delighted him.
sentences.zh: 他的心跳会加快，每翻过一页都会让他更接近那个真正让他欣喜的部分。

sentences.en: The old woman had only pretended to be so kind.
sentences.zh: 老妇人只是假装那么善良。

sentences.en: She was in reality a wicked witch, Armin would read with excitement.
sentences.zh: 阿明兴奋地读到，她实际上是一个邪恶的女巫。

sentences.en: When a child fell into her power, she killed it, cooked it, and ate it, and that was a feast day with her.
sentences.zh: 当一个孩子落入她的魔掌时，她会杀死它、煮熟它并吃掉它，对她来说那是一个节日。

sentences.en: Early in the morning, before the children were awake, she was already up, and when she saw both of them sleeping and looking so pretty, with their plump and rosy cheeks,
sentences.zh: 清晨，在孩子们醒来之前，她就已经起床了，当她看到两个孩子睡得正香、面色红润、双颊胖乎乎的时，

sentences.en: she muttered to herself, That will be a dainty mouthful.
sentences.zh: 她自言自语道：“那将是一口美味。”

sentences.en: Armin considered how lovely it would be to eat another person.
sentences.zh: 阿明思考着吃掉另一个人该是多么美妙的一件事。

sentences.en: In doing so, they would assimilate into him, and he would never again feel the hollow sting of loneliness.
sentences.zh: 通过这样做，他们会融入他体内，他将再也不会感到孤独的空虚刺痛。

sentences.en: As these thoughts fermented in the privacy of Armin's mind, he sought the opinion of the only person he could trust,
sentences.zh: 当这些想法在阿明私密的内心中发酵时，他寻求了他唯一可以信任的人的意见，

sentences.en: an imaginary brother he had formed in response to the overwhelming isolation he experienced.
sentences.zh: 那是他在面对铺天盖地的孤独感时，幻想出的一个兄弟。

sentences.en: Armin had given his imaginary brother the name Frankie.
sentences.zh: 阿明给这个虚构的兄弟取名叫弗兰基。

sentences.en: Decades later, Rottenborg police left Armin's house after executing a search warrant.
sentences.zh: 几十年后，罗滕堡警方在执行搜查令后离开了阿明的住所。

sentences.en: They didn't leave empty handed.
sentences.zh: 他们并非空手而归。

sentences.en: They had confiscated his computer equipment, among other things, and a book of his titled Flesh and Blood.
sentences.zh: 他们没收了他的电脑设备以及一本题为《血肉之躯》的书等物品。

sentences.en: Most significant was the three bags of meat they had taken from his freezer.
sentences.zh: 最引人注目的是他们从他冰柜里带走的的三袋肉。

sentences.en: Once the police were gone, Armin Marvis paced nervously, wanting someone to talk to.
sentences.zh: 警察走后，阿明·马尔维斯紧张地踱着步，渴望找人倾诉。

sentences.en: He couldn't speak with his mother, as she had died several years prior from a heart attack.
sentences.zh: 他无法跟母亲倾诉，因为她几年前因心脏病发去世了。

sentences.en: Armin had lived alone in the house since.
sentences.zh: 自那以后，阿明一直独自在这所房子里生活。

sentences.en: He picked up the phone and called one of his half-brothers.
sentences.zh: 他拿起电话，打给他的其中一个异母兄弟。

sentences.en: His sister-in-law picked up and immediately sensed something was wrong.
sentences.zh: 他的弟媳接了电话，立刻觉得有些不对劲。

sentences.en: Armin admitted that he was in trouble with the police.
sentences.zh: 阿明承认自己惹上了警察。

sentences.en: Do you have a corpse lying in the cellar or something?
sentences.zh: 你地窖里藏了具尸体什么的吗？

sentences.en: His sister-in-law jokingly asked.
sentences.zh: 他弟媳半开玩笑地问道。

sentences.en: He replied,
sentences.zh: 他回答道，

sentences.en: No, in the freezer cheSt.
sentences.zh: 没有，在冰柜里。

sentences.en: She laughed, assuming he was joking.
sentences.zh: 她笑了，以为他在开玩笑。

sentences.en: Armin then called the office where he worked as a computer technician.
sentences.zh: 阿明随后打到了他担任电脑技术员的办公室。

sentences.en: He told his boss that he needed to leave and that he might never come back.
sentences.zh: 他告诉老板自己必须离开，而且可能再也不会回来了。

sentences.en: At 3.30 that afternoon, a call was placed to the Rottenborg police.
sentences.zh: 那天下午3点30分，一通电话打到了罗滕堡警察局。

sentences.en: The caller was Armin Marvis' attorney.
sentences.zh: 打电话的是阿明·马尔维斯的辩护律师。

sentences.en: He said that Armin was with him and was ready to make a full confession.
sentences.zh: 他说阿明正和他在一起，并准备全盘供认。

sentences.en: Throughout his life, Armin Marvis sought gratification for his cannibalistic desires where he could.
sentences.zh: 在其一生中，阿明·马尔维斯总是竭尽所能地满足他对食人欲望的渴望。

sentences.en: As a child, he'd watch his neighbours slaughter hogs for meat to sell.
sentences.zh: 小时候，他会看着邻居屠宰生猪来出售肉类。

sentences.en: In his teens, he shadowed his friend to the butcher shop where he worked, to observe him dismembering animal carcasses.
sentences.zh: 十几岁时，他跟着朋友去其工作的肉铺，观察他分解动物尸体。

sentences.en: It wasn't an unpleasant sight to Armin.
sentences.zh: 对阿明来说，这并不是什么令人不快的场景。

sentences.en: He felt joyful to witness a once-living being serving a profound and important purpose.
sentences.zh: 看到一个曾有生命的生命体发挥出深刻而重要的作用，他感到由衷的高兴。

sentences.en: Whenever someone ate that meat, that animal was with them forever.
sentences.zh: 每当有人吃下那块肉，那只动物就永远陪伴着他们。

sentences.en: He became more creative in his adult years.
sentences.zh: 成年后，他的做法变得更具有创意。

sentences.en: He barbecued Barbie dolls and took delight in the way their plastic bodies melted and warped.
sentences.zh: 他烤芭比娃娃，并对她们的塑料躯体融化和扭曲的方式感到欢欣鼓舞。

sentences.en: He modelled limbs and organs out of marzipan before devouring them as if they were the real thing.
sentences.zh: 他用杏仁膏捏出四肢和器官的形状，然后将它们狼吞虎咽地吃下去，就像真的一样。

sentences.en: He studied serial killer cannibals such as Jeffrey Dahmer and researched recipes ideal for human flesh.
sentences.zh: 他研究过杰弗里·达默等连环杀手食人魔，并搜寻最适合人类血肉的食谱。

sentences.en: He constructed a cardboard diorama of a slaughter room before replicating it in the old smoke room upstairs.
sentences.zh: 他用纸板搭建了一个屠宰室的模型，然后在楼上的旧吸烟室里将其复刻出来。

sentences.en: No one knew what stirred deep inside Armin Marvis' mind.
sentences.zh: 没有人知道阿明·马尔维斯内心深处在酝酿着什么。

sentences.en: He once told a schoolmate about his desire to eat human flesh, but they laughed in response, assuming he was making it up.
sentences.zh: 他曾向一名同学透露过自己想吃人肉的渴望，但对方听后哈哈大笑，以为他是在胡编乱造。

sentences.en: Once Armin got a computer, he was able to indulge in his fantasy in new, shocking ways.
sentences.zh: 阿明有了电脑后，便能够以种种全新且耸人听闻的方式纵情于他的幻想。

sentences.en: He'd digitally alter images of men he had cut from pornographic magazines to appear butchered and bloodied.
sentences.zh: 他会用数码技术修改从色情杂志上剪下来的男人的照片，让他们看起来像是被宰杀和血淋淋的。

sentences.en: He did similar alterations to photos he took of himself.
sentences.zh: 他对给自己拍的照片也进行了类似的修改。

sentences.en: The internet led to Armin discovering that there were many others in the world that had the same morbid interests as him.
sentences.zh: 互联网让阿明发现，世界上有许多人和他有着同样的病态兴趣。

sentences.en: In time, he became Frankie.
sentences.zh: 久而久之，他变成了弗兰基。

sentences.en: The imaginary brother from his childhood had now become a digital persona he used to interact with other cannibal fetishists online.
sentences.zh: 他童年时幻想中的兄弟，如今变成了一个数字角色，用来在网上与其他食人癖好者互动。

sentences.en: Many years later, he crossed virtual paths with a user named Kator.
sentences.zh: 多年以后，他在虚拟世界里与一个名叫卡托的用户不期而遇。

sentences.en: It wasn't until Kator lay drugged and bleeding in his slaughter room that Armin finally learned his real name.
sentences.zh: 直到卡托被麻醉且流着血躺在他的屠宰室里时，阿明才终于知道了他的真名。

sentences.en: Sleep-ins were rare for René Jasnik.
sentences.zh: 雷内·雅斯尼克很少睡懒觉。

sentences.en: The 21-year-old baker was used to getting up early for work, but a week-long holiday in early March 2001 provided him the opportunity to be lazy.
sentences.zh: 这位21岁的面包师习惯早起工作，但2001年3月上旬为期一周的假期让他有了偷懒的机会。

sentences.en: Friday, March 9 marked the final day of said holiday, and René wasn't planning on switching up his routine.
sentences.zh: 3月9日星期五是这段假期的最后一天，雷内并不打算打破自己的作息规律。

sentences.en: He stirred at around 6.40am needing to use the bathroom, and immediately afterwards, he slipped back into bed alongside his sleeping boyfriend, Björnt Brandes.
sentences.zh: 他在清晨6点40分左右醒来上厕所，紧接着又钻回被窝，躺在他正在睡觉的男朋友比约恩·布兰德斯身旁。

sentences.en: René didn't wake up again until almost three hours later.
sentences.zh: 雷内直到将近三个小时后才再次醒来。

sentences.en: The remainder of his day would be spent relaxing at the apartment he shared with Björnt in the city of Berlin, Germany.
sentences.zh: 他剩余的一天将在他和比约恩在德国柏林合租的公寓里度过，十分轻松惬意。

sentences.en: René had the apartment all to himself, as Björnt had already left for work.
sentences.zh: 雷内独自一人待在公寓里，因为比约恩已经出门上班了。

sentences.en: Later that night, René's feelings of relaxation had dissipated.
sentences.zh: 那天深夜，雷内轻松的心情已经消散殆尽。

sentences.en: It was nearing 7.40pm and Björnt was usually home by now.
sentences.zh: 眼看就要到晚上7点40分了，比约恩平时这个时候应该已经到家了。

sentences.en: At first, René was annoyed.
sentences.zh: 起初，雷内感到有些恼火。

sentences.en: He thought Björnt had gone for an after-hours drink with some colleagues and not bothered to inform him.
sentences.zh: 他以为比约恩和同事去喝下班后的酒了，却懒得通知他一声。

sentences.en: But by 10pm, René's irritation gave way to concern.
sentences.zh: 但到了晚上10点，雷内由恼怒转为了担忧。

sentences.en: Björnt was reliable and it was out of character for him not to contact René to let him know why he wasn't home on time.
sentences.zh: 比约恩是个靠谱的人，没能联系上雷内告诉他自己为什么没按时回家，这很不符合他的性格。

sentences.en: Strangely, not only did Björnt's mobile phone go unanswered, but it continued to play an automated voice message that said,
sentences.zh: 奇怪的是，比约恩的手机不仅无人接听，而且一直播放着一条自动语音留言，上面写着：

sentences.en: This connection is temporarily disconnected.
sentences.zh: 该号码已暂时停机。

sentences.en: When Björnt failed to come home that night, René spent the weekend reaching out to all of Björnt's friends and acquaintances trying to track him down.
sentences.zh: 当晚比约恩没能回家，雷内整个周末都在联系比约恩所有的朋友和熟人，试图寻找他的踪迹。

sentences.en: No one had seen the 43-year-old.
sentences.zh: 没有人见过这位43岁的男子。

sentences.en: René called Björnt's office at the technology corporation where Björnt worked as a computer engineer.
sentences.zh: 雷内给比约恩的办公室打了电话，比约恩在那家科技公司担任电脑工程师。

sentences.en: He was met with the answering machine.
sentences.zh: 电话那头只有答录机。

sentences.en: Björnt, it's René here, the machine recorded as René spoke pleadingly.
sentences.zh: 比约恩，我是雷内，录音机记录下雷内恳求的声音。

sentences.en: Desperate for answers, René phoned Björnt's employer and was surprised to learn that Björnt had taken the Friday he disappeared off.
sentences.zh: 急于寻找答案的雷内给比约恩的雇主打了电话，惊讶地得知比约恩在他失踪的那天星期五请了假。

sentences.en: He had told his supervisor that he needed to do so for personal reasons as there was something he wanted to take care of.
sentences.zh: 他告诉主管说自己因个人原因需要请假，因为有些事想去处理一下。

sentences.en: He gave no other details.
sentences.zh: 他没有透露其他细节。

sentences.en: René was confused.
sentences.zh: 雷内感到很困惑。

sentences.en: Björnt had told him he was going into work on Friday.
sentences.zh: 比约恩明明告诉过他，他周五要上班。

sentences.en: He even stated that he had a lot to do that day and would not be reachable on his mobile phone or in the office.
sentences.zh: 他甚至说过那天有很多事情要做，而且在手机上或办公室里都联系不上他。

sentences.en: Thursday night had passed normally, with no hints that Björnt was hiding something.
sentences.zh: 星期四晚上过得很平常，没有任何迹象表明比约恩隐瞒了什么。

sentences.en: When Björnt had left the apartment on Friday morning, he had taken his apartment keys, wallet and mobile phone.
sentences.zh: 周五早上比约恩离开公寓时，带走了他的公寓钥匙、钱包和手机。

sentences.en: René was under the impression that he had indeed gone to work.
sentences.zh: 雷内当时以为他确实去上班了。

sentences.en: Unable to uncover any clues as to where Björnt had really gone, René reported him missing to the police.
sentences.zh: 由于无法查明比约恩究竟去了哪里的任何线索，雷内向警方报了人口失踪。

sentences.en: He told them of their stable, long-term relationship and of Björnt's commitment to his job.
sentences.zh: 他向警方讲述了他们稳定长期的恋爱关系，以及比约恩对工作的敬业精神。

sentences.en: Although he worked long hours, Björnt earned enough for them to live a good life together that was marred only by infrequent arguments over everyday probleMs.
sentences.zh: 尽管工作时间很长，但比约恩赚的钱足够让他们过上美好的生活，唯一的瑕疵就是偶尔为日常生活琐事发生争吵。

sentences.en: In recent months, Björnt had spent his work bonus to spruce up their apartment with expensive furnishings,
sentences.zh: 最近几个月，比约恩用他的年终奖金购置了昂贵的家具来装扮他们的公寓，

sentences.en: and he and René had been eagerly planning an overseas holiday to take later in the year.
sentences.zh: 他和雷内一直热切地计划着今年晚些时候去海外度假。

sentences.en: René maintained that Björnt was happy and ruled out the possibility that he had gone somewhere to take his own life.
sentences.zh: 雷内坚称比约恩过得很开心，并排除了他去某个地方寻短见的可能性。

sentences.en: Any hope that Björnt would resurface to attend a work conference on Monday March 12 was lost when he failed to show up for the event.
sentences.zh: 任何关于比约恩会重新出现并参加3月12日星期一的工作会议的希望，随着他未能出席该活动而彻底破灭。

sentences.en: Three days had now passed since anyone had seen or heard from him.
sentences.zh: 自任何人见到他或听到他的消息以来，已经过去三天了。

sentences.en: He hadn't accessed his bank accounts over the weekend, nor had he used company funds which were also available to him.
sentences.zh: 他在周末期间没有登录过银行账户，也没有动用他同样可以使用的公司资金。

sentences.en: To those who knew Björnt, his sudden disappearance was perplexing.
sentences.zh: 对于那些认识比约恩的人来说，他的突然失踪令人费解。

sentences.en: Police had little luck locating him in the following weeks.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几周里，警方搜寻他的进展甚微。

sentences.en: With no word from his missing boyfriend, René Jasnik reached out to former journalist Nina Herman,
sentences.zh: 在失踪的男朋友杳无音信的情况下，雷内·雅斯尼克联系了前记者妮娜·赫尔曼，

sentences.en: who had previously worked for a local newspaper, hoping she could track Björnt down using her investigative skills.
sentences.zh: 她曾为当地一家报纸工作，雷内希望她能利用自己的调查技能追踪到比约恩。

sentences.en: After questioning employees at Björnt's work, Nina made a small discovery.
sentences.zh: 在质问了比约恩公司的员工后，妮娜有了一个小小的发现。

sentences.en: One of Björnt's colleagues had seen him on the morning of his disappearance at Bahnhof Zoo train station in Berlin.
sentences.zh: 比约恩的一位同事在失踪那天早上的柏林动物园火车站见过他。

sentences.en: He thought nothing of the sighting, as he knew Björnt took a train to work each day.
sentences.zh: 他当时没把这次偶遇放在心上，因为他知道比约恩每天都坐火车去上班。

sentences.en: Armed with a photograph of Björnt, René and Nina scoured the train station for clues and questioned staff, shop owners and travellers to determine where he might have gone to next.
sentences.zh: 雷内和妮娜手拿着比约恩的照片，在火车站搜寻线索，并询问工作人员、店主和旅客，以确定他接下来可能去了哪里。

sentences.en: No one recalled seeing Björnt, so René posted his photo in the local newspaper, hoping that it would generate some leads.
sentences.zh: 没有人记得见过比约恩，于是雷内把他的照片发在当地报纸上，希望借此能提供一些线索。

sentences.en: It didn't.
sentences.zh: 并没有用。

sentences.en: He had seemingly vanished into thin air.
sentences.zh: 他仿佛凭空消失了一般。

sentences.en: In truth, he was bagged up in pieces at the bottom of Armin Mivis' freezer.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他被分装在袋子里，塞在阿明·马尔维斯的冰柜底部。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 档案节目稍后回归。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的赞助商广告来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持档案节目继续提供优质内容。

sentences.en: Armin Mivis maintained that he didn't know Björnt Brandes was in a relationship when they met.
sentences.zh: 阿明·马尔维斯坚称，他们见面时他并不知道比约恩·布兰德斯处于恋爱关系中。

sentences.en: In his confession, Armin said he knew very little about Björnt's personal life.
sentences.zh: 在供述中，阿明说他对比约恩的个人生活知之甚少。

sentences.en: Although Björnt, as Cator, mentioned having a friend, Armin didn't know that this person was a romantic partner with whom Björnt had lived with.
sentences.zh: 尽管比约恩化名卡托时曾提到过有一个朋友，但阿明并不知道这个人是比约恩与之同居的恋爱伴侣。

sentences.en: In hindsight,
sentences.zh: 现在回想起来，

sentences.en: it offered an explanation for a remark Björnt had made to Armin when they returned to Castle Wilhelmsfjör train station following their failed first attempt at the slaughter.
sentences.zh: 这为主办第一次屠宰尝试失败后返回威廉斯菲尔城堡火车站时比约恩对阿明说的一句话提供了解释。

sentences.en: Describing his recollections from the station to author Gunther Stampf for his book Interview with the Cannibal, Armin explained that Björnt was intending to go home until he said,
sentences.zh: 阿明在向作家冈瑟·斯塔姆夫讲述他关于火车站的回忆时解释说，比约恩当时原本打算回家，直到他说出了这样的话：

sentences.en: If I go back to Berlin now, I'll be facing a showdown.
sentences.zh: 如果我现在回柏林，我将面临一场摊牌。

sentences.en: Armin queried the cryptic remark, but Björnt didn't elaborate.
sentences.zh: 阿明对这句隐晦的话提出了质疑，但比约恩没有详细阐述。

sentences.en: Could he have been agonising over having to explain his abrupt disappearance to his boyfriend, René?
sentences.zh: 他当时是不是在为必须向男朋友雷内解释自己突然失踪一事而痛苦煎熬？

sentences.en: It could have led to the unravelling of his double life, simultaneously ruining both.
sentences.zh: 这可能会导致他双重生活的瓦解，同时毁掉两边的一切。

sentences.en: Author Gunther Stampf noted that Björnt faced a literal life-or-death impasse.
sentences.zh: 作家冈瑟·斯塔姆夫指出，比约恩面临着字面意义上的生死绝境。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 原话是，

sentences.en: Between returning home and slaughter.
sentences.zh: 在回家与被屠宰之间。

sentences.en: Between reason and madness.
sentences.zh: 在理智与疯狂之间。

sentences.en: Björnt chose death, slaughter, and madness.
sentences.zh: 比约恩选择了死亡、屠宰和疯狂。

sentences.en: The reasoning behind Björnt's decision, including why he sought to be eaten, died with him.
sentences.zh: 比约恩做出这一决定的背后的逻辑，包括他为何渴望被吃掉，随着他的离世而一同掩埋。

sentences.en: He didn't pen a suicide note or record a goodbye message.
sentences.zh: 他没有留下遗书，也没有录下告别留言。

sentences.en: Comments and behaviour in the lead-up to his fateful day-ex were otherwise normal.
sentences.zh: 他在决定命运的那天之前的言行举止都很正常。

sentences.en: Right before he left to meet with Armin Mivis, Björnt did a clean sweep of his personal computer, eradicating all trace of their communications.
sentences.zh: 就在他出门去见阿明·马尔维斯之前，比约恩对他的个人电脑进行了一次彻底清理，消除了他们所有通信的痕迹。

sentences.en: It was obvious that he didn't want anyone in his life to know about Kator.
sentences.zh: 很明显，他不想让生命中的任何人知道卡托的存在。

sentences.en: Medical professionals retroactively examined Björnt's life to uncover what might have led him on his path of self-destruction.
sentences.zh: 医学专家追溯性地审视了比约恩的一生，试图找出是什么导致他走上了自我毁灭的道路。

sentences.en: At age five, Björnt's mother ended her own life.
sentences.zh: 在比约恩五岁时，他的母亲结束了自己的生命。

sentences.en: Björnt was forbidden to talk about her death to his father, and as an only child, he had no one else to turn to.
sentences.zh: 比约恩被禁止跟父亲谈论她的死，作为独生子，他无可依靠。

sentences.en: Their relationship soured from then onwards.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，他们的关系急转直下。

sentences.en: Björnt's father was a cold, tyrannical man who was never impressed by Björnt, despite his successes in life.
sentences.zh: 比约恩的父亲是一个冷酷暴虐的男人，尽管比约恩在生活中取得了成功，但他从未对儿子刮目相看。

sentences.en: By the time Björnt was an adult, the pair were practically estranged.
sentences.zh: 到了比约恩成年时，两人几乎已经形同陌路。

sentences.en: Then, Björnt was cut off from his father's life entirely when he revealed he was in a relationship with a man.
sentences.zh: 后来，当比约恩透露自己与一名男子恋爱时，他彻底被父亲断绝了关系。

sentences.en: Doctors speculated that Björnt's masochism stemmed from feelings brought on by his father, either the hatred Björnt had for him,
sentences.zh: 医生推测，比约恩的受虐倾向源于他父亲带给他的情感，要么是比约恩对父亲的恨意，

sentences.en: or the hatred Björnt had of himself as a result of his father's disapproval.
sentences.zh: 要么是由于父亲的不满而导致比约恩对自己的憎恨。

sentences.en: Björnt's father was reluctant to speak about his son after learning what he had done.
sentences.zh: 得知儿子所做的事后，比约恩的父亲不愿谈论他。

sentences.en: In a brief conversation with a physician, he said that Björnt's childhood and youth development were uneventful.
sentences.zh: 他在与一位医生的简短交谈中说，比约恩的童年和青少年发育都很平淡无奇。

sentences.en: Björnt had a string of failed relationships, both with men and women, which linked to the overarching theme of rejection.
sentences.zh: 比约恩经历了一连串失败的恋爱关系，无论是与男性还是女性，这都与他一直以来面临的被拒绝这一主线有关。

sentences.en: Yet, there was nothing to prove that any of this was the catalyst for his actions.
sentences.zh: 然而，没有任何证据证明这一切是促成他行为的导火索。

sentences.en: If he had any depressive moods or other mental disorders, Björnt hid them well.
sentences.zh: 如果他有过抑郁情绪或其他精神障碍，比约恩也把它们隐藏得很好。

sentences.en: March 9 was not a significant date in his life, and the word kator wasn't found to be relevant either.
sentences.zh: 3月9日对他的一生来说并不是一个重要的日子，人们也没有发现“卡托”这个词有什么关联。

sentences.en: The only person who could offer any true insight into Björnt's cannibalistic desires was the person who carried them out.
sentences.zh: 唯一能对比约恩的食人欲望提供真正见解的人，就是那个付诸行动的人。

sentences.en: Armin Mivis said being consumed was Björnt's ultimate ecstasy, his life goal.
sentences.zh: 阿明·马尔维斯说，被吃掉是比约恩的终极狂喜，是他的人生目标。

sentences.en: His death was his, quote,
sentences.zh: 他的死是他（原话）的

sentences.en: ultimate sexual climax.
sentences.zh: 终极性高潮。

sentences.en: The slaughter didn't play out that way.
sentences.zh: 屠宰的过程并没有那样展开。

sentences.en: Björnt didn't get to experience the euphoric feeling of being eaten alive that he had longed for.
sentences.zh: 比约恩并没有体验到他一直渴望的那种被活活吃掉的欣快感。

sentences.en: His day-axe had ended disappointingly, with him bleeding out in Armin Mivis's slaughter room.
sentences.zh: 他那决定命运的一天以令人失望的方式结束了，他在阿明·马尔维斯的屠宰室里因流血过多而濒死。

sentences.en: Dressing the wound did little to stem the flow, and Björnt was insistent that an ambulance not be called.
sentences.zh: 包扎伤口对止血无济于事，并且比约恩坚决要求不要叫救护车。

sentences.en: He turned to Armin and said, As soon as I'm asleep, cut my throat.
sentences.zh: 他转向阿明说：“我一睡着，就割断我的喉咙。”

sentences.en: With a potent mix of blood loss, cold medicine, sleeping pills, and alcohol impacting Björnt's body,
sentences.zh: 失血过多、感冒药、安眠药和酒精的混合作用强烈影响着比约恩的身体，

sentences.en: Armin suspected he would pass out soon.
sentences.zh: 阿明猜测他很快就会昏迷过去。

sentences.en: Yet, half an hour later, Björnt was still awake.
sentences.zh: 然而，半小时过去了，比约恩仍然醒着。

sentences.en: Armin, I'm so cold, he said, before requesting to be put in a warm bath to expedite his bleeding.
sentences.zh: “阿明，我好冷，”他说，随后要求泡个热水澡以加速流血。

sentences.en: Armin obliged.
sentences.zh: 阿明答应了。

sentences.en: He removed Björnt's bandages, as Björnt lowered into the warm water.
sentences.zh: 当比约恩沉入温水中时，他取下了比约恩的绷带。

sentences.en: Seeing the blood spurt from his open wound uplifted him.
sentences.zh: 看到鲜血从开放性伤口中喷涌而出，他感到振奋。

sentences.en: At this point, Björnt wanted to go to sleep in the bathtub and bleed to death.
sentences.zh: 此时，比约恩只想在浴缸里睡去并流血至死。

sentences.en: Armin went to his bedroom and read, stopping every quarter hour to return to the bathroom and check if Björnt had died.
sentences.zh: 阿明回到卧室看书，每隔十五分钟停下来去浴室查看比约恩是否已经死亡。

sentences.en: Two and a half hours passed, and Björnt remained conscious.
sentences.zh: 两个半小时过去了，比约恩特依然保持着清醒。

sentences.en: As Björnt went to lift himself out of the tub, he blacked out and his body crumbled to the floor.
sentences.zh: 正当比约恩特试图从浴缸里撑起身体时，他突然眼前一黑，整个身体瘫倒在地板上。

sentences.en: Armin began carrying Björnt's limp body back upstairs to the slaughter room, at which point Björnt stirred awake.
sentences.zh: 阿明开始把比约恩特瘫软的身体搬回楼上的屠宰室，就在这时，比约恩特苏醒了过来。

sentences.en: With a sudden burst of energy, he tried to walk by himself.
sentences.zh: 他爆发出突然的力量，试图自己走路。

sentences.en: He believed that by doing so, his blood would flow out better and he would pass out faster.
sentences.zh: 他相信这样做能让血液流得更畅快，从而能更快地昏迷过去。

sentences.en: Then, you can finally do it, he told Armin.
sentences.zh: 这样一来，你就可以彻底动手了，他对阿明说道。

sentences.en: Armin got Björnt back into the slaughter room and returned to checking on him every quarter hour.
sentences.zh: 阿明把比约恩特弄回屠宰室，并恢复了每十五分钟查看他一次的习惯。

sentences.en: Then, at 3.30am, he heard Björnt stirring about and went to see what he was up to.
sentences.zh: 随后，在凌晨三点半，他听到比约恩特在动弹，便过去查看情况。

sentences.en: He found Björnt sprawled out on the floor.
sentences.zh: 他发现比约恩特大字形地瘫倒在地板上。

sentences.en: He had managed to pull himself out of bed, but had tripped over in the darkness.
sentences.zh: 他好不容易才从床上挪下来，却在黑暗中绊倒了。

sentences.en: Armin roused Björnt, who remarked,
sentences.zh: 阿明唤醒了比约恩特，后者说道：

sentences.en: I've got to piss.
sentences.zh: 我得去撒尿。

sentences.en: Armin dissuaded Björnt from moving.
sentences.zh: 阿明劝阻比约恩特不要乱动。

sentences.en: If you stand up now, you'll be dead.
sentences.zh: 你现在要是站起来，就会没命的。

sentences.en: You have no blood left in you.
sentences.zh: 你体内已经没有血了。

sentences.en: Delirious, Björnt insisted he needed to go to the toilet.
sentences.zh: 神志不清的比约恩特坚持说他必须去洗手间。

sentences.en: He stood up, but within seconds, his legs gave way and he fell to the floor.
sentences.zh: 他站了起来，但仅仅几秒钟内，他的双腿便支撑不住，跌倒在地板上。

sentences.en: This time, Armin couldn't wake him.
sentences.zh: 这一次，阿明怎么也叫不醒他了。

sentences.en: Armin donned a plastic apron.
sentences.zh: 阿明穿上了一条塑料围裙。

sentences.en: He placed Björnt's naked body on the table in the centre of the room, where he tied it down.
sentences.zh: 他将比约恩特赤裸的身体放在房间中央的桌子上，并将其捆绑固定。

sentences.en: After a farewell kiss and a brief prayer, Armin hesitated.
sentences.zh: 在献上一个告别吻和一段简短的祈祷后，阿明犹豫了一下。

sentences.en: The feeling passed quickly.
sentences.zh: 这种情绪很快就过去了。

sentences.en: He tilted Björnt's head slightly, then inserted a knife into his neck.
sentences.zh: 他微微倾斜比约恩特的头部，随后将一把刀刺入他的颈部。

sentences.en: It had been ten hours since Björnt's ordeal had begun.
sentences.zh: 此时距离比约恩特的折磨开始已经过去了十个小时。

sentences.en: When speaking of the killing to author Gunter Stampf, Armin recalled having an indescribable feeling of anger and joy at the same time.
sentences.zh: 在向作家贡特·施坦普夫谈及这场谋杀时，阿明回忆说，自己当时有一种难以言喻的愤怒与喜悦交织的复杂感觉。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 引述如下：

sentences.en: On the other hand, I had an unbelievable feeling of happiness.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，我有一种难以置信的幸福感。

sentences.en: It all went the way Björnt wanted.
sentences.zh: 这一切都完全按照比约恩特的意愿发展。

sentences.en: For years, Armin had studied medical textbooks and searched the internet for the ideal slaughter technique.
sentences.zh: 多年来，阿明一直在研读医学教科书，并在互联网上搜寻理想的屠宰技术。

sentences.en: Now, he put his knowledge into practice.
sentences.zh: 现在，他将自己的知识付诸实践。

sentences.en: After an hour of intense work, Armin switched his butcher's apron for a pair of pyjamas and slept peacefully.
sentences.zh: 经过一个小时的紧张劳作，阿明脱下屠夫围裙，换上睡衣，安然入睡。

sentences.en: The mutilation of Björnt Brandes' body continued the following day of Saturday, March 10.
sentences.zh: 对比约恩特·布兰德斯遗体的毁坏工作在3月10日星期六这天继续进行。

sentences.en: On Sunday, Armin sat alone at the end of his dining table.
sentences.zh: 星期天，阿明独自坐在餐桌的一头。

sentences.en: He had dressed it for the occasion with his finest tablecloth, a black porcelain dining set, polished cutlery, and a glass of his favourite red wine.
sentences.zh: 他为此精心布置了餐桌，铺上了最上等的桌布，摆好黑色瓷质餐具、擦得发亮的银制餐具，并斟了一杯他最爱的红酒。

sentences.en: The table's centrepiece, a candelabra, created a warm ambience.
sentences.zh: 餐桌正中央摆着一个烛台，營造出温馨的氛围。

sentences.en: On a plate before Armin was a piece of Björnt Brandes' upper back, cooked, seasoned, and served with the sauce.
sentences.zh: 阿明面前的盘子里，是一块比约恩特·布兰德斯的上背部肉，经过烹制、调味，并浇上了酱汁。

sentences.en: As detailed in the book Cannibal by Lois Jones, Armin said a short prayer that ended,
sentences.zh: 正如露易丝·琼斯所著书籍《食人魔》中所详细记载的那样，阿明做了简短的祈祷，祷告词的结尾是：

sentences.en: Lord God, thank you for providing me with a friend for life and for sacrificing Björnt's life on earth for me.
sentences.zh: 主啊，感谢你为我赐予了一生的朋友，并让比约恩特在尘世的生命为我做出牺牲。

sentences.en: I hope I won't be lonely anymore.
sentences.zh: 我希望我以后不再孤单。

sentences.en: As Armin ate, he said,
sentences.zh: 阿明一边吃着，一边说道：

sentences.en: This is the most tasty meal I've ever had.
sentences.zh: 这是我吃过最美味的一餐。

sentences.en: Nothing is so delicious.
sentences.zh: 没有什么比这更美味了。

sentences.en: His words were directed to Björnt's decapitated head, which Armin had positioned on the dining table next to him.
sentences.zh: 他这番话是对着比约恩特被砍下的头颅说的，阿明把它摆在身旁的餐桌上。

sentences.en: He eventually buried Björnt's head in his backyard, along with Björnt's arms, legs, and feet.
sentences.zh: 最终，他将比约恩特的头颅以及他的双手、双腿和双脚一起埋在了后院里。

sentences.en: In the months that followed, Armin ate 45 out of the 65 pounds of human flesh he had stored in his freezer.
sentences.zh: 在随后的几个月里，阿明吃掉了存放在冰箱里的65磅人肉中的45磅。

sentences.en: He even ate it at work in the form of rissols, with his colleagues none the wiser.
sentences.zh: 他甚至在工作时把人肉做成肉饼吃掉，而同事们对此浑然不知。

sentences.en: Armin believed that through this process, he was absorbing Björnt's characteristics and talents.
sentences.zh: 阿明坚信，通过这个过程，他正在吸收比约恩特的性格和才能。

sentences.en: Björnt had a decent grasp of the English language, and Armin felt his English speaking was improving with each meal.
sentences.zh: 比约恩特的英语相当不错，阿明觉得每吃一顿，自己的英语口语就在进步。

sentences.en: Despite having got exactly what he had wanted, Armin wound up back online, scrolling through cannibal forums as Frankie.
sentences.zh: 尽管如愿以偿，阿明最终还是回到了网络上，以“弗兰基”的化名在食人论坛里浏览。

sentences.en: Emboldened by having done what other users only fantasised about, Armin started bragging about his real-life cannibalism experience.
sentences.zh: 由于亲身做到了其他用户只能幻想的事情，阿明胆子大了起来，开始吹嘘自己现实中的食人经历。

sentences.en: He also posted gory pictures he had taken when he butchered Björnt's remains.
sentences.zh: 他还发布了自己在屠宰比约恩特遗体时拍摄的血腥照片。

sentences.en: Yet, his taste for human flesh had not been satisfied.
sentences.zh: 然而，他对人肉的胃口并未得到满足。

sentences.en: Eighteen months after Björnt Brandes's slaughter, Armin received an email.
sentences.zh: 比约恩特·布兰德斯被杀十八个月后，阿明收到了一封电子邮件。

sentences.en: Someone had responded to his ad titled,
sentences.zh: 有人回复了他题为以下的广告：

sentences.en: Boys Sought for Butchering.
sentences.zh: 寻寻求宰割的男孩。

sentences.en: It was a 23-year-old man from the Austrian town of Vinsbruck, named Reinhold.
sentences.zh: 那是一个来自奥地利温斯布鲁克镇、名叫赖因霍尔德的23岁年轻人。

sentences.en: From there, Armin Maivus's double life completely unravelled, leaving those who knew him as a seemingly harmless, friendly and helpful man utterly shocked.
sentences.zh: 自此，阿明·迈维斯的双重生活彻底败露，让那些视他为一个看似无害、友善且乐于助人的人感到震惊不已。

sentences.en: Following Armin's confession, police returned to his Wusterfeld manor to undertake a more thorough search.
sentences.zh: 在阿明供认不讳后，警方返回他位于武斯特费尔德的庄园进行更彻底的搜查。

sentences.en: Björnt's head and limbs were uncovered in the backyard, just as Armin had forewarned.
sentences.zh: 正如阿明此前预告的那样，比约恩特的头颅和四肢在后院被发掘出来。

sentences.en: Inside the house, officers discovered a collection of VHS tapes concealed in a bookshelf.
sentences.zh: 在屋子里面，警员们在书架里藏着的一堆录像带中有了发现。

sentences.en: What they contained caused many of those who watched them to seek psychological counselling.
sentences.zh: 这些录像带的内容导致许多观看过的人不得不寻求心理辅导。

sentences.en: At just over eight hours long, Armin had videotaped everything that had occurred in the slaughter room between him and Björnt Brandes.
sentences.zh: 这段录像时长刚过八小时，阿明用摄像机记录了他与比约恩特·布兰德斯在屠宰室里发生的一切。

sentences.en: This included the severing of Björnt's penis, his eventual death, and the butchering of his remains.
sentences.zh: 其中包括切除比约恩特的阴茎、他最终的死亡以及对他遗体的解剖切割。

sentences.en: A meticulous record keeper, Armin had also kept copies of all the interactions he had online with Björnt Brandes.
sentences.zh: 作为一个一丝不苟的记录者，阿明还保留了他在网上与比约恩特·布兰德斯的所有互动副本。

sentences.en: There were pages upon pages of email and chat correspondence between the pair, in which they discussed the upcoming slaughter in gory and gratuitous detail.
sentences.zh: 两人之间有成页成页的电子邮件和聊天记录，其中以血腥且毫不避讳的细节讨论了即将到来的屠宰过程。

sentences.en: As the act of cannibalism was not a crime in Germany, lengthy deliberations were held to determine what exact charges Armin Maivus would face.
sentences.zh: 由于在德国吃人行为并不属于犯罪，司法部门进行了长时间的审议，以确定阿明·迈维斯究竟该面临何种指控。

sentences.en: Armin's attorney felt he should have been charged with killing on request, as Armin had acted only to fulfil Björnt's wish to die.
sentences.zh: 阿明的律师认为应该指控他受托杀人，因为阿明完全是为了满足比约恩特求死的愿望而行事的。

sentences.en: The prosecution disagreed.
sentences.zh: 检方并不同意这种说法。

sentences.en: While they accepted that Björnt's consent was a condition for his killing, it was not the motivating reason.
sentences.zh: 尽管他们承认比约恩特的同意是其被杀害的前提条件，但这并不是动机所在。

sentences.en: They argued that Armin killed Björnt in order to butcher him and to satisfy his own fetish to consume male flesh.
sentences.zh: 他们辩称，阿明杀害比约恩特是为了将其肢解，并满足自己食用男性肉体的癖好。

sentences.en: They sought a conviction based on the charge, murder for sexual satisfaction.
sentences.zh: 他们要求以“为满足性欲而谋杀”的罪名对其定罪。

sentences.en: As per German law, in a criminal case involving the death of a person, the jury was composed of three professional judges and two members of the public.
sentences.zh: 根据德国法律，在涉嫌人员死亡的刑事案件中，陪审团由三名专业法官和两名平民陪审员组成。

sentences.en: Seventy-one seats in the public gallery were awarded at random by lottery, as citizens and journalists vied to witness the macabre spectacle in person.
sentences.zh: 公众旁听席上的七十一个席位是通过随机抽签分配的，市民和记者们争相亲眼目睹这一令人毛骨悚然的奇观。

sentences.en: The trial itself began one year after Armin Maivus was arrested.
sentences.zh: 审判本身在阿明·迈维斯被捕一年后开始。

sentences.en: A number of self-confessed cannibals gathered outside in support of Armin, with one telling a reporter,
sentences.zh: 一些自认是食人者的群体聚集在外面支持阿明，其中一人对记者说道：

sentences.en: There are lots of us out there.
sentences.zh: 我们这样的人多得很。

sentences.en: We admire Armin because he had the guts to see this thing through.
sentences.zh: 我们崇拜阿明，因为他有胆量把这件事贯彻到底。

sentences.en: Armin appeared calm and collected in a suit and tie.
sentences.zh: 阿明身穿西装、系着领带，显得冷静而沉着。

sentences.en: One onlooker told a New York Times reporter that Armin looked like the nicest cannibal you could ever meet.
sentences.zh: 一名旁听者对《纽约时报》记者说，阿明看起来就像你能遇到的最友善的食人魔。

sentences.en: When Armin took the stand, he spoke for hours.
sentences.zh: 当阿明走上证人席时，他滔滔不绝地讲了几个小时。

sentences.en: At no point did he show any emotion or express any remorse.
sentences.zh: 他自始至终没有流露出任何情绪，也没有表达任何悔意。

sentences.en: Show me the statute that says what I've done is against the law, he said pointedly at the prosecution.
sentences.zh: 指给我看哪条法律规定我做的事是违法的，他针锋相对地质问检方。

sentences.en: He reiterated that Björnt wanted to die and that he was merely assisting him.
sentences.zh: 他重申比约恩特渴望死去，而自己只是在协助他。

sentences.en: Quote
sentences.zh: 引述如下

sentences.en: My friend enjoyed dying.
sentences.zh: 我的朋友很享受死亡。

sentences.en: For him, it was a nice death.
sentences.zh: 对阴暗的他来说，这是一次美好的死亡。

sentences.en: Björnt came to me of his own free will to end his life.
sentences.zh: 比约恩特是出于他自己的自由意志来到我这里结束生命的。

sentences.en: I accept this is taboo, but I can justify what I did to God and the world.
sentences.zh: 我承认这是禁忌，但我对上帝和世人问心无愧。

sentences.en: He denied killing Björnt for sexual satisfaction, saying,
sentences.zh: 他否认为了满足性欲而杀害比约恩特，并说道：

sentences.en: I didn't want to have sex with the partner I chose to slaughter.
sentences.zh: 我并不想与我选择屠宰的伴侣发生性关系。

sentences.en: That had nothing to do with it.
sentences.zh: 这跟那完全没有关系。

sentences.en: One has sex with a partner in bed, not with a piece of meat.
sentences.zh: 人们是在床上和伴侣发生性关系，而不是和一块肉。

sentences.en: It had nothing to do with sexual arousal.
sentences.zh: 这与性唤起毫无关系。

sentences.en: By eating, I wanted to make this person become part of me.
sentences.zh: 通过食用，我想让这个人成为我的一部分。

sentences.en: At one stage, the courtroom was emptied so only the jury could watch the videos Armin had recorded of him and Björnt in the slaughter room.
sentences.zh: 在审判的某个阶段，法庭被清空，只允许陪审团观看阿明录下的他与比约恩特在屠宰室的视频。

sentences.en: The footage had been heavily edited to remove imagery deemed too graphic, but what remained still greatly disturbed those who viewed it.
sentences.zh: 这段影像经过了大量剪辑，删去了被认为过于血腥的画面，但剩下的内容依然极大地震惊了观看者。

sentences.en: Please do it this way, Björnt was recorded, telling Armin.
sentences.zh: 请就这样做，根据记录，比约恩特对阿明说道。

sentences.en: Get another knife.
sentences.zh: 拿另一把刀来。

sentences.en: The footage conveyed what Armin had hoped.
sentences.zh: 录像印证了阿明的期望。

sentences.en: Björnt was a willing participant who prompted, consented and encouraged everything Armin did to him.
sentences.zh: 比约恩特是一个自愿的参与者，他催促、同意并鼓励了阿明对其实施的一切行为。

sentences.en: But it also showed something that was not favourable to the defence.
sentences.zh: 但它也展现出了一些对辩方不利的情况。

sentences.en: Analysis of the footage revealed Björnt was still breathing when Armin had killed him.
sentences.zh: 对影像的分析显示，当阿明将其杀死时，比约恩特依然有呼吸。

sentences.en: Björnt's body was also shown to be restrained to the table, as if to keep him still.
sentences.zh: 录像还显示比约恩特的身体被绑在桌子上，仿佛是为了让他保持静止。

sentences.en: This contradicted Armin's testimony, in which he said he thought Björnt was dead before he inserted the knife through his throat.
sentences.zh: 这与阿明的证词相矛盾，他此前曾供称在将刀刺入对方喉咙前以为比约恩特已经死了。

sentences.en: The nearly 500 emails and messages between Frankie and Kator were also read out to the court.
sentences.zh: 法庭上还宣读了弗兰基和卡托之间近500封电子邮件和信息。

sentences.en: These favoured the defence, as it showed a, quote,
sentences.zh: 这些对辩方有利，因为它们显示了一种，引述如下：

sentences.en: Willingness agreement between the two men, in which Björnt Brandes fully consented to being slaughtered by Armin Maivis.
sentences.zh: 双方自愿达成的协议，其中比约恩特·布兰德斯完全同意被阿明·迈维斯屠宰。

sentences.en: In his closing statement, Armin spoke of his correspondence with Austrian student Reinhold, which ultimately led to his arreSt.
sentences.zh: 在最后陈述中，阿明谈到了他与奥地利学生赖因霍尔德的通信，这最终导致了他的被捕。

sentences.en: If I hadn't been so stupid as to keep looking on the internet, Armin said, I would have taken my secret to the grave.
sentences.zh: 阿明说，要是我当初没有愚蠢到一直在网上搜索，我就会把这个秘密带进棺材里了。

sentences.en: Armin Maivis appeared at ease when it came time to hear the court's verdict.
sentences.zh: 轮到听取法庭裁决时，阿明·迈维斯显得十分从容。

sentences.en: The preceding judge acknowledged that after viewing the slaughter video, it was clear that Armin took no pleasure in the actual killing of Björnt Brandes.
sentences.zh: 审判长承认，在观看了屠宰录像后，很明显阿明在杀害比约恩特·布兰德斯的过程中并未获得任何快乐。

sentences.en: He went on to say,
sentences.zh: 他接着说道：

sentences.en: Both Maivis and Brandes were looking for the ultimate kick.
sentences.zh: 迈维斯和布兰德斯都在寻找终极刺激。

sentences.en: This was an act between two extremely disturbed people who both wanted something from each other.
sentences.zh: 这是一个发生在两个极其反常的人之间的行为，他们都从对方身上得到了自己想要的东西。

sentences.en: The courtroom fell silent when the verdict was read.
sentences.zh: 宣读判决时，法庭一片寂静。

sentences.en: The judge explained that while Armin had committed a behaviour which is condemned in our society, there was an express request by Björnt Brandes to be killed.
sentences.zh: 法官解释说，尽管阿明实施了被我们社会所谴责的行为，但比约恩特·布兰德斯确实表达了被杀害的明确请求。

sentences.en: As such, the court found that what Armin had done was killing a person without being a murderer.
sentences.zh: 因此，法院裁定阿明所做的是“在不具备谋杀性质的情况下剥夺他人生命”。

sentences.en: Armin Maivis was convicted of manslaughter and sentenced to eight and a half years imprisonment.
sentences.zh: 阿明·迈维斯被判处过失杀人罪，获刑八年半。

sentences.en: With good behaviour, he was up for release in under four and a half years.
sentences.zh: 若表现良好，他将在不到四年半的时间内获得假释。

sentences.en: Despite receiving a somewhat favourable outcome, Armin Maivis appealed the verdict, insisting his actions fell under killing on requeSt.
sentences.zh: 尽管得到了还算有利的结果，阿明·迈维斯还是对判决提起了上诉，坚称他的行为属于受托杀人。

sentences.en: He wasn't the only one to appeal.
sentences.zh: 他并不是唯一一个上诉的人。

sentences.en: The state attorney was horrified by the light sentence and believed he should have been found guilty of murder.
sentences.zh: 州检察官对如此轻的判决感到震惊，认为他应该被判谋杀罪名成立。

sentences.en: Fifteen months later, the initial trial's outcome was reversed.
sentences.zh: 十五个月后，最初的审判结果被推翻。

sentences.en: Armin Maivis was to be retried for murder.
sentences.zh: 阿明·迈维斯将因谋杀罪接受重审。

sentences.en: At the conclusion of Armin Maivis' retrial in May 2006, it was determined that the killing of Björnt Brandes did in fact fulfil all the requirements for murder.
sentences.zh: 在2006年5月阿明·迈维斯重审结束时，法院裁定杀害比约恩特·布兰德斯的行为实际上完全符合谋杀的所有构成要件。

sentences.en: The court decided that Armin had motivating reasons that were in his self-interest to kill Björnt, namely sexual gratification.
sentences.zh: 法院认定阿明杀害比约恩特具有出于自身利益的动机，即性满足。

sentences.en: Therefore, it was not a one-sided mercy killing.
sentences.zh: 因此，这并非一起单方面的安乐死。

sentences.en: The state prosecutor said,
sentences.zh: 州检察官说道：

sentences.en: You wanted to record a film in your head, a hit film, a film you could play again and again so you could satisfy yourself sexually.
sentences.zh: 你想在脑海里录制一部电影，一部卖座电影，一部你可以一遍又一遍播放以满足自己性欲的电影。

sentences.en: Armin rebuked the decision, saying,
sentences.zh: 阿明驳斥了这一裁决，说道：

sentences.en: It was not a sex thing.
sentences.zh: 这不是什么性爱的事。

sentences.en: Every bite I took of him brought me closer to my brother.
sentences.zh: 我吃他的每一口都让我离我的兄弟更近一步。

sentences.en: I wanted to eat him.
sentences.zh: 我想吃掉他。

sentences.en: I didn't want to kill him.
sentences.zh: 我并不想杀他。

sentences.en: In his final courtroom speech, Armin stated,
sentences.zh: 在法庭上的最后发言中，阿明陈述道：

sentences.en: I believe everyone should be able to decide what he wants to do with his own body.
sentences.zh: 我认为每个人都应该能够决定自己想对自己的身体做什么。

sentences.en: Armin Maivis was found guilty of murder and sentenced to life imprisonment.
sentences.zh: 阿明·迈维斯被判谋杀罪名成立，并被判处终身监禁。

sentences.en: Armin Maivis' lawyer believed that the sentence handed down to his client was purposely excessive to deter any further aspiring cannibals to act on their impulses.
sentences.zh: 阿明·迈维斯的律师认为，判处其当事人如此严厉的刑罚是故意为之，旨在震慑其他任何企图将冲动付诸行动的潜在食人者。

sentences.en: Armin would later admit to author Gunther Stampf that no punishment would have deterred him from slaughtering and eating Björnt Brandes, even the death penalty.
sentences.zh: 阿明后来向作家冈瑟·施坦普夫承认，哪怕是死刑也无法阻止他屠宰和食用比约恩特·布兰德斯。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 引述如下：

sentences.en: Detectives have endeavoured to track down all those who corresponded with Armin Maivis online
sentences.zh: 侦探们一直致力于追查所有曾在网上与阿明·迈维斯联系过的人

sentences.en: to uncover a thriving cannibal network across Europe that Armin estimated had at least 800 members.
sentences.zh: 以期揭开欧洲一个蓬勃发展的食人网络，阿明估计该网络至少拥有800名成员。

sentences.en: Armin assisted the detectives, who managed to identify 200 people and uncover several more possible cannibal killings.
sentences.zh: 阿明协助了侦探们，他们成功辨认出了200人，并揭发了多起可能的食人谋杀案。

sentences.en: Many of those involved were highly educated individuals in successful, well-respected careers, such as dentists, teachers, and government officials.
sentences.zh: 许多涉案人员都是受过高等教育、拥有成功且备受尊重的职业的人士，例如牙医、教师和政府官员。

sentences.en: In 2004, Armin Maivis sued German heavy metal band Rammstein upon the release of their controversial single,
sentences.zh: 2004年，阿明·迈维斯起诉了德国重金属乐队里姆施泰因，起因是该乐队发行了备受争议的单曲：

sentences.en: Mindtile.
sentences.zh: 《Mindtile》。

sentences.en: Referred to as the cannibal song, Mindtile, which is slang for my penis, contained lyrics inspired by Armin Maivis' crimes.
sentences.zh: 被称为食人歌的《Mindtile》（这是我阴茎的俚语），其歌词灵感正是源自阿明·迈维斯的罪行。

sentences.en: Considered one of the band's most notable live performances,
sentences.zh: 被视为该乐队最引人注目的现场表演之一，

sentences.en: Mindtile sees a band member performing in a giant cooking pot that is set alight by lead singer Till Lindemann,
sentences.zh: 在《Mindtile》的表演中，一名乐队成员站在一个巨大的烹饪锅里，主唱蒂尔·林德曼将锅点燃，

sentences.en: who dons a blood-stained chef's apron while holding a microphone with a large real knife attached to the end.
sentences.zh: 他穿着一件沾满血迹的厨师围裙，手里拿着一个话筒，话筒末端绑着一把大号真刀。

sentences.en: Armin Maivis claimed the band had no right to make a song about his story without his permission.
sentences.zh: 阿明·迈维斯声称该乐队无权未经他允许就将他的故事写成歌曲。

sentences.en: The suit never reached court.
sentences.zh: 这起诉讼最终没有开庭审理。

sentences.en: Armin was able to get a 2006 film based on his crimes, titled Rotenborg Butterfly, a grim love story,
sentences.zh: 阿明曾成功让一部根据他的罪行改编、名为《罗滕堡蝴蝶》的2006年电影——一部阴暗的爱情故事——

sentences.en: temporarily banned in Germany after complaining it infringed on his personal rights.
sentences.zh: 在德国被暂时禁映，因为他投诉该片侵犯了他的个人权利。

sentences.en: The ban was overturned in 2009 after Germany's Federal Court of Justice ruled that the producer's right to artistic freedom trumped that of Armin's personal rights.
sentences.zh: 2009年，德国联邦最高法院裁定制片人的艺术自由权高于阿明的个人权利，该禁令随之被推翻。

sentences.en: Recent reports state that Armin Maivis is a model prisoner, who is described by fellow inmates and guards alike as popular, friendly, and polite.
sentences.zh: 最新报道称，阿明·迈维斯是一名模范囚犯，狱友和看守都形容他受欢迎、友好且礼貌。

sentences.en: As a result, he is allegedly allowed to leave prison with two escorts and in disguise to wander around the local town.
sentences.zh: 因此，据称他被允许在两名押解人员陪同并伪装的情况下离开监狱，在当地城镇闲逛。

sentences.en: He also professes to have become a vegetarian.
sentences.zh: 他还声称自己已经成为了一名素食主义者。

sentences.en: Armin applied for parole in 2017, but was unsuccessful.
sentences.zh: 阿明于2017年申请假释，但没有成功。

sentences.en: Further parole bids have been denied because of his poor social prognosis in the community and his lack of remorse for his actions.
sentences.zh: 由于他在社区中的不良社会预测以及对自己的行为缺乏悔意，其随后的假释申请均被驳回。

sentences.en: While Armin was diagnosed with schizoid personality by criminal psychologists, they have found him to have no signs of actual mental illness.
sentences.zh: 尽管犯罪心理学家诊断阿明患有分裂型人格，但他们发现他并没有真正精神疾病的迹象。

sentences.en: A journalist for German newspaper Berlina Morgenpost once wrote of Armin Maivis.
sentences.zh: 德国《柏林晨报》的一名记者曾这样评价阿明·迈维斯。

sentences.en: The one who listens to him learns a lot about loneliness and alienation, and about the dark side of an otherwise iridescent medium, the internet.
sentences.zh: 倾听他的人能了解到很多关于孤独与疏离的信息，以及关于互联网这个本应斑斓多彩的媒介黑暗一面的信息。

sentences.en: It is opening up so many opportunities, but at the same time, it is providing invisible accomplices in countless dark chambers.
sentences.zh: 它开启了无数的机会，但与此同时，它也为无数黑暗房间里的罪恶提供了看不见的帮凶。

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。
